scientific_integrity.claim_scope: All ordered q-symbol alphabets, q>=2, with exact one-pass tortoise map; q=1 base case, q=4 explicit root.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact maximum-letter language decomposition, a uniquely parsed renewal sublanguage, rational generating function coefficient comparison, positive dominant pole, four-letter forbidden-factor bound.
scientific_integrity.unproved_extensions: No all-n coefficient formula for q>=4, no iterated-map image rates or Shannon output entropy.
scientific_integrity.verification_basis: Independent recursive/stack implementations and direct grammar enumeration of 52389 inputs, plus exact sextic polynomial arithmetic.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns sets of one-step outputs and their Hartley growth, not the probability distribution of outputs or Shannon entropy.
The general alphabet growth constant is specified implicitly by an exact algebraic renewal equation; no bounded-degree formula uniform in the alphabet is claimed.
The ternary image generating function and its growth constant are preexisting special-case information, not asserted as original.
An unindexed equivalent result remains a residual priority risk; independent audit has not taken place.
title: Renewal entropy of the finite-alphabet tortoise image language
